long_biography.plain_text:
As deputy chairman of the Bahamas Maritime Authority, Peter John Goulandris has spent decades connecting a major ship registry with the international shipping community. A Harvard graduate who has lived and worked in the Bahamas, he joined the authority when it was formed, bringing long private-sector shipping experience to flag-state administration.

Goulandris's industry work extended beyond fleet management. He chaired the International Tanker Owners Pollution Federation for roughly fifteen years and held leadership roles in marine insurance and technical-standard bodies. He also entered ceramics as deputy chairman of Waterford Wedgwood and executive chairman of its ceramics division. That appointment paired his family investment stake with responsibility for restructuring Waterford and Wedgwood operations.
